limitations: Natural Earth 1:10m is generalized cartography, not a 10-metre mask. Absence of mapped land is not proof of no small island or valid water data.
Country polygons are modern land context, not historical coastline reconstruction.
All preserved frame rectangles are visible geographic footprints; this does not model label occlusion as grounds for discarding data.
No missing cell is filled with zero height or fabricated imagery. Source/renderer admission remains false.
